justification: APBS 3.4.1 and PDB2PQR 3.6.1 installed cleanly and reproduced bundled regression tests to 6+ decimals, matching documented values across versions, supporting numerical stability. The analytical Born-ion benchmark agreed within 0.45%, well within expected discretization error. The APBS+PDB2PQR end-to-end pipeline ran successfully on a real protein (1AKI) with sensible energies and grid convergence. Minor limitations are that not all new features from the paper (e.g., geometric flow, TABI-PB, Python API) were exercised and no published reference value exists for the 1AKI case.
one_line: APBS/PDB2PQR replicates paper's benchmarks with high precision; pipeline works and results are stable across versions.
